prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview & Customize Your Desktop Pet", "Check how your pet looks in desktop preview mode before rendering.", "Upload Pet Photo"]
1: ["Desktop Display Diagnostic", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and multi-monitor desktop support.", "Screen Overlay Permission Granted", "Test Desktop Pet Spawn"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try out these essential shortcut controls to interact with your pet anywhere on your screen.", "Drag to Move • Double Click to Talk • Right Click to Hide", "Launch Pet On Desktop"]
3: ["Save Your Adoption Certificate", "Sign in to save your pet's name, custom appearance, and progress to your cloud account.", "Use your primary sign-in method to sync existing pets."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Companion", "Pick an instant ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photo.", "Instant Adoption vs Custom Photo Pet", "Continue to Selection"]
5: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account method to automatically recover your existing pets."]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Method", "Instant Adoption takes 10 seconds with pre-made pets. Custom Pet creation turns any pet photo into a 3D desktop companion in 1 minute."]
7: ["Clear lighting and single pet photos produce the best desktop pet renders.", "Face Visible • Good Lighting • Single Pet", "Auto-Enhance Active"]
8: ["Building Your Desktop Pet...", "Generating 3D mesh, desktop animations, and behavior routines.", "Generating Desktop Animations..."]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Use Ctrl+Pet to summon, right-click menu to configure settings, or drag anywhere.", "Desktop Shortcuts & Quick Controls", "Start Playing With Pet"]
